## Failure paths and arms (fill in)

None inside this chain. This record is the ForceCommand-off first apply: `pilot_access_gateway_install_forcecommand=false`, the scope `pilot-target-all` not yet published. The gateway played its first-apply degraded acceptance (Step 17: `status=degraded`, `freeipa=reachable`, `credential=ok`, `target_scope=missing`, independently confirmed by Step 13's `ipa hostgroup-show`), and the apply, the L3 fresh-host dry-run and the L6 rerun (`changed=0` on both nodes) all passed. Right after the chain, `/v1/health` on the gateway read `degraded`/`target_scope: missing`; after `pilot gateway-scope reconcile --scope all --hosts ipa1.ipa.pilot.internal` (recap `failed=0 changed=1`) it read `ok`/`target_scope: ok`. The ForceCommand-on re-apply and the `--tags AG06` arms are in the companion record `2026-11-16-00a82df8-forcecommand.md`.
Only the freeipa-server spec is verified in this chain (20/20): the gateway's own spec needs the published scope and the ForceCommand drop-in, so it is verified in the companion record (33/33).

## Not covered / limits (fill in)

- Two nodes only (a FreeIPA server and the gateway host), not the five-node minimal PoC. The five-node clean-room run was done on candidate `56e6734a` (tree `5d1de35389221e07a406c73452b74dfee3866504`); between it and this candidate the only execution-affecting change is the `AG06` row tag on the Step 17 gate and its notice in `playbooks/apply/pilot-access-gateway-apply.yml` (plus its regression test). The other fixes of that PR (hosts-alias FQDN resolution, replica rsyslog restart, alertmanager example, delivery evidence retry, Alertmanager editor status) are exercised here only where they sit on these two nodes' paths: the alias helper by `ag6-gw`, a not-yet-enrolled inventory host, being enrolled by name, and the first-apply gateway path; the replica rsyslog restart, the Alertmanager pieces and the F7 retry under real store contention are not exercised.
- The gateway host is Ubuntu 24.04 and the FreeIPA server AlmaLinux 9, as in the PoC. No other OS, no second gateway, no `--tags` selection other than `AG06` on the live gateway.
- The binaries were built from this candidate (`GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false`, `CGO_ENABLED=0`, `-trimpath -ldflags="-s -w"`); their SHA-256 differ from the five-node run's binaries because the build flags and toolchain differ, and no non-test Go file changed between `56e6734a` and this candidate.
- `pilot gateway-scope` was given an explicit host (`ipa1.ipa.pilot.internal`, the FreeIPA server) because `--hosts all` resolves to the `freeipa-client` group, whose only member here is the gateway itself, which `gateway-scope` excludes; the PoC's `all` scope held two other clients.
- Known open product finding G1 (kjelly/pilot#336, the fact-cache directory `vm-target` cleans is not the one `pilot deploy` reads) does not apply: the node names were new, so no cached facts existed for them.
- Spec rows outside `docs/verification/freeipa-server.md` (this record) or `docs/verification/pilot-access-gateway.md` (the ForceCommand record) were not run here.
